text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —*pant... gasp...*!! Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(So far away... N-No, this is wrong...! 
Run, go, move...!)
"Stick to your guns, no matter what."
"‘Hold on to your pride until the end.’"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh! DAAAMN IIIT...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~...! So that's this year's Derby 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, it was super intense this year too... 
Wait, huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur... She has kind of a scary look 
on her face...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...It's no good.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I lost... A total defeat. So damn lame, 
lame, lame..."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I wanted to overturn... that damn dream...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
("This" kind of loss isn't supposed to 
happen. It's an outcome "Parcae" didn't 
anticipate.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(In other words... there was a change. 
Even if a loss is still a loss—)

When Air Shakur returned, he wore a 
complicated expression. And understandably 
so...

An outcome unforeseen by "Parcae"... In 
other words, she overturned the 
prediction... but she still lost.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: How lame.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
However... facts are facts. I overcame 
that 7 cm gap.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: In the lamest way possible... but still.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: It's still too early.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I gotta report the results to "Parcae."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Depending on that, the absolute worst 
outcome might be waiting for us.

Whether changing the margin of victory 
would alter the dark fate ahead... She had 
once told me that was the most important 
question.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what comes next is what really 
counts. Whether the nightmare continues or 
not...—

After returning to the academy, Air Shakur 
sat facing the computer for a while. And 
then...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Parcae"... threw an error on me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"...No, the other functions seem fine. 
I'll run a check."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know the cause, but errors have 
started popping up only regarding win/loss 
results.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In all the races ahead, I couldn't see the 
placements anymore.
choice_data_list: Does that mean... destiny has changed?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
In truth, it's after the 7cm switch. Maybe 
we should go ahead and lock it in.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
What's waiting up ahead ain't hell. It's a 
completely blank, brand-new unknown, 
that's what.
choice_data_list: Which means the Senior Class is...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You're jumping the gun. Just because the 
outcome isn't clear doesn't mean the 
causes leading to that worst-case fate 
have vanished.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Well, let's put that topic aside for now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"I might even totally bomb the Kikuka Sho 
that I was supposed to win next."

Our next target is the final crown, the 
Kikuka Sho... According to "Parcae," this 
victory would make Air Shakur a Double 
Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If a crushing defeat is possible, then 
there's also the chance for a massive 
upside...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She might even win by a huge margin. Well, 
can't say for sure, though.

Could it be... that Air Shakur is looking 
forward to the future for the very first 
time?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, come to think of it, summer camp's 
coming up real soon.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I had already decided on the training 
menu, but... I suppose I'll have "Parcae" 
reconstruct it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
The other functions work fine. Its 
processing power, its analytical 
capability... It's all still totally 
usable. I ain't throwing it out.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
She is getting closer to reaching the 
conditions for winning her first Kikuka 
Sho.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If she exceeds that theoretical limit 
during summer camp, we might see results 
beyond anything we expected.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: —...It's no use.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If I don't know what caused the error, 
there's no way in hell I can fix it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Besides, the mystery still remains. Those 
numbers, "991031021222"... Why did they 
appear, and why did they suddenly vanish?)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Parcae"... What are you trying to tell 
me?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Are you stupid? There's no way something 
like that exists.
